steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each account's balance is placed through the day against its movements.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 projected balance falls below the minimum

findings.title: Balance not equal to yesterday plus movements
findings.fix: Recompute the balance from the movements

findings.title: Payment due with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the payment

Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

pros: Checks an account balance that does not match the previous day's balance plus the movements, a payment due with no source, and a projected balance below the stated minimum.
cons: Not checked: Uncleared items; bank-side errors.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-fin-cash-position skill on the records for this review.
